visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit television studio. Two hosts, a man with curly hair in a black t-shirt and a woman in a black and white striped t-shirt with a lobster print, stand in the center. Behind them are several contestants, mostly women, sitting at individual desks with small chalkboards. The set features vibrant, geometric neon lights and graphic backgrounds. (2) The camera cuts to close-ups of the contestants as they listen to the host explain the rules. One contestant, a man in a light blue striped shirt, sits at the front, looking thoughtful and then animated. On-screen graphics show a grid with a question mark. (3) The scene becomes more chaotic as the contestants start shouting guesses. They hold up their chalkboards with handwritten Chinese characters. The male contestant in the striped shirt is particularly expressive, waving his hands and leaning forward. (4) Finally, the male contestant shouts an answer, and the screen reveals the character '零' (zero). The studio erupts in excitement, with contestants and hosts clapping and cheering. The male contestant jumps up and down in his seat.
